>
[Summon Wood Elemental](/Feats.aspx?ID=4321) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ardande" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=498" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 49

</column>

---

Your connection to the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25) allows you to summon elemental allies. Once per day, you can cast [_summon elemental_](/Spells.aspx?ID=320) as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental must be a [wood elemental](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=345).
name: Summon Wood Elemental
